properties.subject: Event published with technical round ending after RFQ
properties.content: Our two-stage event has a technical round that ends on 14 Oct, after the RFQ closes on 12 Oct, and the system still let us publish it. Vendors are now quoting prices before the technical evaluation is done. Event link: https://app.example.com/events/abc123?token=XYZ987

properties.subject: Error 712 when extending technical round
properties.content:
Hello,
When I try to extend the technical stage by two days I get error 712 RFP duration exceeds RFQ end time. How do I extend it?
Thanks
Kavita Shah

thread.text:
Hi Kavita,
This is expected behaviour: the technical round cannot end after the pricing round. You need to extend the RFQ end time first, then the technical round.
Best regards,
Vikram Singh
